newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT - Korean shares rise on trade figures.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT - Korean shares rise on trade figures.

text.p: Korean global depositary receipts rose again Thursday, buoyed by an improving economic picture in Seoul, traders said.
Encouraging current account figures and a better interest rate environment helped semi-conductor and banking shares, traders said.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index gained 2.16 points to 74.65 points, a premium of 47.50 percent over the local market.
The Seoul composite index rose 4.375 points to end the day at 742.50, the highest close so far this year.
Cho Hung Bank gained 72 cents to $6.62 and LG Electronics soared 72 cents to $5.12.
"There are very few sellers now, and with the local market up I can't see anything but rising premiums for the next little while," a trader said.
The Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 0.01 points down at 81.28, with the premium over the local market at 25.31 percent from 26.78 percent.
Bombay's benchmark index closed up 38.0 points to 3,723.31.
Reliance gained 17 cents to $18.75/$19.75 and Hindalco lost 12 cents to $31.75/$32.75.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index rose 0.05 points, or 0.04 percent, to 114.88, representing a discount to the local market of 2.32 percent.
